item.title: AI models can provably hide arbitrary capabilities
Crypto thieves sell hardware wallets with secret eSIM
Jailbreaking a Kindle via Autonomous Agent Feedback Loops
item.description: An engineer repurposed an idle e-reader into a custom photo display by deploying an LLM agent to negotiate device architecture and compile local firmware hacks. While the experiment showcases automated hardware hacking, it highlights how brittle manual verification remains when agents lack direct environmental perception.

item.title: The Volume Fallacy: Agents Write More Code, Leaving Software Craft Behind
item.description: Autonomous coding tools excel at churning out raw syntax, yet fail to improve the underlying architecture or reduce technical debt. The fundamental trade-off lies in multiplying the volume of maintenance overhead while masking human architectural decline.

item.title: The 'Toolness' Spectrum of AI
item.description: Framing conversational AI purely as a 'tool' misses the point; instead, LLMs exist on a vast gradient from deterministic utility to autonomous agenthood, much like human collaborators or unpredictable machinery. Quote: LLM's exist on a vast gradient of 'toolness -> agent'. Humans exist on that spectrum too.

item.title: Kevin Kelly's 2016 AI Predictions, 10 Years Later
The Privacy-Utility Dilemma in Frontier AI
item.description: Developers face a challenging trade-off between utilizing bleeding-edge frontier models and maintaining data privacy, leading some to seek alternative providers or open-source solutions despite governance and transparency concerns. Quote: If you don't trust OpenAI and Anthropic to follow their own policies, how do you decide what companies to trust? Vibes?

item.title: The Evolution of 'Open' and the Rise of Open-Washing
item.description: The tech community reflects on how corporate definitions of 'open' have shifted from historical restrictive proprietary SDKs and NDAs to modern debates around open weights versus true open-source, highlighting a growing need to call out 'open-washing.' Quote: Maybe we should start talking about open-washing (like green-washing is to ecological statements).
